summary: The note is a short wiki-style entry on baseball player Willie Mays. It highlights his two National League MVP awards, his 660 career home runs, and his record-tying 12 Gold Glove awards, which began in 1957 when the award was introduced.
one_line: Willie Mays was a baseball star noted for two NL MVP awards, 660 home runs, and 12 Gold Glove awards.
key_facts: Willie Mays won two National League (NL) Most Valuable Player (MVP) awards.
Willie Mays ended his career with 660 home runs.
Willie Mays's 660 career home runs were third at the time of his retirement.
Willie Mays's 660 career home runs were fifth all-time as of the note's writing.
Willie Mays won a record-tying 12 Gold Glove awards.
Willie Mays's Gold Glove awards began in 1957.
The Gold Glove award was introduced in 1957.
